method.cases: 4 fixed cases declared before this run; one trial per case; no cherry-picked retries. The compact set covers three scenarios, three languages and corrected beginner/math modes within the remaining allowance.
method.team: Scout selects a bounded evidence tool, then writes. Guide writes from supplied facts and glossary; Host reads their actual outputs plus deterministic calculation and check. Four model calls per fresh case.
method.baseline: One model call writes the same three editorial roles using the same evidence, role briefs, calculations and source verdict. No tool-selection round trips.
method.scoring: Identical editorial guards and citation checks. Guard acceptance is not semantic truth. No model judge. No audience study.
method.cost: Requests and reported tokens; no inferred dollar cost.
method.pacing: Each case starts at least 75 seconds after the previous case to stay within the existing deployment capacity. No retries. Earlier incomplete attempts and a recovery run that exposed an unsupported influence claim are retained separately.
